title: Wall Mount paper towel holder 15-Inch Solid Brass Retro Wave Collection Allied Brass
description:
Keep countertops clean and clutter-free with a wall mount paper towel holder crafted from solid brass. Designed as part of the retro wave collection, it brings a refined, traditional look while saving space.

Highlights:
- Wall-mounted design helps free up counter space
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
- Coordinates with matching retro wave pieces for a cohesive setup
- Multiple designer finish options available

Specs:
- Dimensions: 15 in H x 4 in L x 2.25 in W; 5 in projection
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Assembly: No assembly required
- Included: Paper towel holder and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
